proposal.reason: Primary change is new MPI native tests for communicator lifecycle APIs (`pcclCommGetUniqueId`, `pcclCommGrow`, `pcclCommRevoke`/`Shrink`) and their expected runtime behavior after parent destruction or revocation; CI is additionally required because the PR substantively adds a new `comm_lifecycle_810e` test family, wires new binaries into daily workflow/build scripts, and updates platform case-count expectations/documented test-set composition.
